# Product Requirements Document: Repository & Blast Radius Analysis

## Ingestion Features
* R1: User can upload a Markdown file as a PRD spec to parse requirements.
* R2: User can scan a code repository to index modules and function signatures.

## Graph Visualization
* R3: User can view a graph representation of requirements connected to UI elements.
* R4: User can view Absence nodes highlighting specification gaps.

## Blast Radius Engine
* R5: User can compute a blast-radius of modified files to trace risk impact.
* R6: User can generate a plain-English narrative quality assurance report.
